## v1.36.5

Error details are richer and several input gaps are closed. Nothing should break existing code, except that a tool `request.params` value that is not a string now throws `bad_request`.

### Added

- `err.retryAfter` (whole seconds) on any failed answer that carries a `Retry-After` header. It reads a count of seconds or an HTTP date. It is `undefined` when the header is missing, unreadable or too large. (#428)
- The rate-limit (429) `err.detail` names the limit and window the server reports. (#428)
- Typed errors `voice_has_no_samples` and `upload_file_type_restricted`, each with a hint. (#428)
- `provider` (`vertex` or `bedrock`) in `setModelConfiguration`. (#428)

### Changed

- Dev dependencies (`playwright`, `undici`) and the CodeQL action are updated. Live CI is hardened against outside flakes. (#422, #423, #425, #426, #429)

### Fixed

- `threads.delete([])` throws `validation_error` before any request. (#428)

### Behavior change

- Tool `request.params` values must be strings. A value of another type throws `bad_request` and names the key. (#428)

### Docs and skill

- List filters, threads, push, search, skills, lifecycle, tools, rate limits and error handling match what a caller sees. This includes which code a single call (`api_exception`, `error.status` is 200) and a failed call inside a multirequest (`ovp_error`) throw. (#427)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kaltura/intelligent-agents-sdk/compare/v1.36.0...v1.36.5
